synopsis: A man tries to unfold a simple cloth napkin, only to discover it contains an impossible, endless supply of fabric within its small, unchanging form.
narration: This napkin is doing a crazy thing. I keep pulling, and it just never seems to end! I've already got a huge pile here, but the original still...

shots.prompt: A neatly folded square white cloth napkin, soft linen with a subtle weave, appearing impossibly thick and dense, its visible edges hinting at an internal, endless fabric mass. The napkin contains an infinitely unfolding internal space, allowing endless amounts of fabric to be pulled from its center while its external dimensions remain unchanged. The composition is a fixed, eye-level view of hands interacting with the napkin on the dark wood living room table. A familiar living-room coffee table: dark wood top with two pale water rings, a folded magazine at the frame edge, the soft blur of a sofa behind, and warm lamp light mixed with grey window daylight. A pair of hands wearing a plain black crew-neck t-shirt already pulls a long, flowing length of crisp white linen fabric from the center of a neatly folded square napkin, which remains fully visible on the dark wood surface.
shots.violation_observation: A continuous length of fabric visibly emerges from the center of the folded napkin, which remains unchanged in size.
